acceptanceCommands: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres@localhost:5432/<freshly-created> PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests -m 'not live and not demo_contract' -q
doNotInfer: Do not skip or xfail these tests. They exercise the tenant-context seam against real Postgres, which is the point of them.
Do not verify against a database left over from an earlier run. The bug IS the leftover; reusing one hides it. Create an empty database for the check.
Do not add the module to the isolation list instead. A private database would also start without the schemas — isolation fixes contention, not provisioning.

Do not assume this is the last of the class. Three tests on this wave depended on state another module happened to create; the accidental provider was removed by #1405 and each dependent surfaced separately.
